steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Wahhhhhhh!!!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Tch, another failure. He's flying in a nice arc this time though.

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Where did he land?

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: No idea. He'll come running back after a while anyway. Let's keep going.

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Okay, what does this tube connect to——

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Haha, this looks like a good port, I'm plugging it in!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Hey, is it working?

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: No. Do you even know what you're doing?!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: What are you yelling for? I've never seen an engine like this before, just let me experiment a bit!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: I want to try!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: I think this tube goes here. What does this button do then? Who cares, just press it.

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: You're the one who's messing around! It obviously goes here!

steps.name: Archosauria C
steps.text: What are you two idiots doing? The gas pipe isn't even connected. Let me do it!

steps.name: Archosauria C
steps.text: Hmm, what does the gas pipe go to... Never mind, this port looks bigger, this is probably it!

steps.name: Archosauria C
steps.text: Hey, somebody try to start it!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: I'm back!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Youngsters nowadays really have no respect for their elders. No one bothered to look for me after I got blasted away!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: But, High Priest, you always come back safe. Everyone's gotten used to it!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Stop wasting time, let's get on with the testing!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Yeah, yeah, alright.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Big Ugly, my child, it's time to wake up!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Ohh! Great Chief, it's moving!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: This wonderful engine sound! I've never heard anything so amazing!

steps.name: Archosauria C
steps.text: Haha, told you I'd get it done!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: How did you do it?

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Just as you saw, Great Chief, it moved just like that!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: We plugged this tube here and that one there!

steps.name: Archosauria C
steps.text: Just like how we built the Big Ugly!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Ahh, the Big Ugly, once but a pile of scrap metal, is now truly majestic. I'm so moved. It makes me want to sing!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: But you're bad at singing.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: I'm sorry?! Fine. I think I have a real talent for singing though... Terrible!

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Oh? Maybe it's a style problem.

steps.name: High Priest
steps.text: Yes, that's right. That has to be the reason. Next time, I'll try singing in bel canto!

steps.name: Archosauria
steps.text: Great Chief, someone broke in!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Is it Gavial? I...

steps.name: Archosauria
steps.text: No! It's a weirdo carrying a pile of weapons!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Zumama's tribe should be right ahead.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Damn, look what she's done to her own tribe.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: It looks pretty cool!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Eh? It seems pretty lively inside.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? Why are they fighting?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Damn Reunion, you're trying to steal Kay's name now! That's something even more precious than honey biscuits! You'll pay for this!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Gaaaaaaaah!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Where did this weirdo come from? She's too strong!

steps.name: Archosauria C
steps.text: I can't understand what she's saying. What the hell's a Reunion?!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Eh, isn't that Kay?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Sounds like Kay's making a ruckus in there.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Let's calm her down first!
